meta.name: Plein
meta.description: For Philipp Plein, more is more. Between Cannes, New York, Milan, and L.A., he drives his fashion empire forward-and pushes everyone around him to their limits. But while his girlfriend Andreea struggles with her health and his mother Hanne stands up to him, the very thing that matters most to Philipp begins to falter: control.

videos.title: CHRISTMAS À LA PLEIN
videos.overview: Philipp Plein lives by one principle: more is more. Juggling family and his empire between Cannes, New York, and L.A., he's working to have his estate in Cannes-complete with a gigantic sculpture-ready for the big fashion show in a few months. But a Christmas argument with his mother, Hanne, escalates. And in L.A., Philipp's girlfriend, Andreea, is about to undergo breast surgery.
